paragraphs.english: The speaker began at noon. It played a repeating alarm from the lower road while a truck moved slowly behind it. Infected people emerged from houses, fields, and trees. Rain reduced the sound's range, and abandoned cars divided the crowd, but dozens still reached the mountain road. Han's men stopped below the last turn. They intended to let hunger, noise, and pressure conduct the attack for them.
paragraphs.chinese: 正午，扩音器启动。它在下方道路反复播放警报，一辆卡车缓慢跟在后面。感染者从房屋、田地和树林中出现。雨水缩短了声音传播距离，废弃车辆也分散了人群，但仍有数十个感染者踏上山路。韩的人停在最后一个弯道下方，打算让饥饿、噪声和压力替他们发动攻击。

paragraphs.english: The first impact struck the outer gate twenty minutes later. Their father held the inner bar while Shuo added boards where the frame began to split. Yang used battery power for the radio and one work lamp. He refused to start the generator because its engine would create a second sound source inside the wall. Yu reported movement from the ridge. Their mother kept the treatment table clean and measured drinking water into cups so fear would not make anyone consume too much.
paragraphs.chinese: 二十分钟后，第一次冲击撞上外门。父亲顶住内侧横杆，硕在门框开始开裂处补上木板。洋只用电池为收音机和一盏工作灯供电，拒绝启动发电机，因为发动机会在墙内制造第二个声源。雨报告山脊动静，母亲维持治疗台清洁，并把饮水按杯分配，防止恐惧让人过量消耗。

paragraphs.english: A section of the drainage ditch collapsed under the crowd, directing several bodies toward the east wall. The stonework moved. Shuo and his father could not support both gate and wall. Yang connected a portable speaker to a long cable and placed it beyond the west side before the attack. He turned it on for thirty seconds. Part of the crowd changed direction, but the cable was torn out. The brief delay allowed them to support the east wall with timber.
paragraphs.chinese: 排水沟的一段在人群重压下坍塌，把数个身体引向东墙。石墙开始移动。硕和父亲无法同时支撑大门与围墙。洋在袭击前已用长电缆把一个便携喇叭放到西侧墙外，此时让它响了三十秒。一部分尸群改变方向，但电缆很快被扯断。这短暂延误让他们有时间用木料支撑东墙。

paragraphs.english: Han's men advanced when they saw the defense weaken. Yu flashed the work lamp toward their truck, and Yang sent Mei's warning over the open radio channel. Voices answered from the quarry. Some camp members had not known Han's plan. The argument did not create a perfect union, but it delayed the men with rifles. Then the truck slid on mud and struck a fallen tree. Its horn became the loudest sound on the road, drawing much of the crowd downhill. Han escaped on foot with several followers.
paragraphs.chinese: 韩的人看到防线减弱后开始靠近。雨用工作灯照向卡车，洋则通过开放无线电频道播出梅的警告。采石场有人回应，原来部分营地成员并不知道韩的计划。争论没有形成完美联盟，却拖住了持枪者。随后卡车在泥地打滑，撞上倒树，喇叭成为山路上最大的声源，把大量感染者重新引向坡下。韩和几名追随者徒步逃走。

paragraphs.english: The attack declined after dark, but survival looked like destruction. The east wall had fallen. The water tank was cracked, the roof leaked above the food room, and rain had entered the generator. Their father could no longer lift his left arm after holding the gate. Shuo's forearm required six stitches. DQ had cut one paw on stone, and Fries had rubbed his muzzle raw while struggling. Regardless of victory, the house could not sustain another night like this. They had defended the base and lost it at the same time.
paragraphs.chinese: 入夜后，袭击逐渐减弱，但幸存下来的景象却近乎毁灭。东墙倒塌，水箱开裂，食品室上方漏雨，发电机也已进水。父亲顶门后左臂再也抬不起来，硕的前臂需要缝六针。DQ的爪子被石头割伤，薯条挣扎时把口鼻磨破。不管这是否算胜利，山屋都无法再承受同样的一夜。他们守住了基地，也在同一刻失去了它。
